string.text: Smooth barrel rollback
A more uniform distribution of the recoil impulse over time has a beneficial effect on shooting in long bursts.
Changing the barrel cutting pitch
Increases the initial speed of the bullet, due to which the bullet deviates less from the expected trajectory and reaches the target faster.Useful for long range shooting.
Barrel adjustment
Allows you to reduce the spread of bullets, which has a beneficial effect on the accuracy of firing.
Improved DTK
Improving the muzzle compensator can significantly reduce recoil.
Heavy Duty Parts
Replacing standard parts with analogues made of high-strength alloys makes it possible to increase the wear resistance of weapons.
Anatomical handle
Provides the right hand with a more comfortable grip.
Bayonet
Installing a standard 6x5 bayonet on a weapon allows you to use the machine gun as a melee weapon.
Light alloy parts
Replacing standard parts with analogues made of light alloys significantly reduces the weight of the weapon.
Modification of the cartridge supply unit
Refinement of the ammunition supply unit makes it possible to reduce the number of delays associated with non-feeding and misalignment of the cartridge.
High capacity magazine (black, 45 rounds)
Allows you to reduce the number of reloads in battle, increasing your chances of staying alive.
High capacity magazine (brown, 45 rounds)
Allows you to reduce the number of reloads in battle, increasing your chances of staying alive.
High capacity magazine (60 rounds)
Allows you to send even more opponents to the best of two worlds with one burst.
Improved backplate
The installation of an anatomical rubberized butt plate reduces the felt recoil from shots fired by the shooter.
Lightweight stock
Reduces the weight of weapons, allowing you to carry more ammunition or an additional artifact during a sortie.
Strengthening the bolt group
Makes the bolt mechanism more resistant to wear and damage, thereby increasing the reliability of the weapon.
Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Forcing USM
Refinement of trigger units makes it possible to increase the rate of fire of weapons, unfortunately, at the cost of some reduction in reliability.
USM calibration
Individual fitting and balancing of standard parts of the firing mechanism allows for higher shooting accuracy while reducing recoil.
Shutter Balancing
Balancing the bolt group parts reduces the barrel moving away from the line of sight when firing, and also reduces the likelihood of delays when firing.
